theme: An open day with a few decisions coming due.
greeting: Nothing's on the calendar today, Dan — a clear day to spend as you like. But a couple of bookings are quietly coming due, Erika's waiting on your Brunswick interview times, and Amin's recruiter call opens tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: Pick your Brunswick interview times
needsAttention.detail: Erika sent availability for separate Teams calls with Jonathan Doorley and Christian and is waiting for you to choose so she can send schedulers — Jonathan opens on 10/27.

needsAttention.title: Amin's recruiter call, 9:30 tomorrow
needsAttention.detail: A recruiter call with Amin Noorani opens your day tomorrow; a few minutes tonight on the opportunities he's bringing will make it land.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December-break destination
needsAttention.detail: Your own deadline to book the three-week December trip is Oct 15 — decide domestic vs. international first, since the kids' passports won't be in hand when you book.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: The refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is a month past its book-this-week date, and holiday inventory is the thinnest of the year.

flagged.title: OECD governance meeting invite
flagged.detail: A contact heard you'd left KPMG and wants you at the OECD corporate-governance meeting in November, with a few sessions to shape together.

flagged.title: Fund your Morgan Stanley account
flagged.detail: A final reminder that your new Signature Savings account needs its initial deposit, plus a separate nudge to add beneficiaries.

flagged.title: ICGN Plenary 7 planning call
flagged.detail: Claudia is still gathering panelist availability for your plenary; Rachit sent his, so a call time is close.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promotions — your St. Pete local digest and the Stewardship Digest.

resolved.title: Maine ferry tickets sorted
resolved.detail: Your Vinalhaven ferry reservation came through Monday and you forwarded it on to Mike.

recipe.title: Translucent Apple Tart
recipe.why: Autumn's apples are at their peak now, crisp and worth baking down into something glassy and golden.
